features.name: Read Simple Rows
features.description: Parses three CSV records and materializes every field as text.

features.name: Read Typed Records
features.description: Parses three CSV records and materializes typed scalar values.

features.name: Read Large Dataset
features.description: Parses and materializes 10,000 typed CSV records.

features.name: Quoted Fields
features.description: Parses doubled quote escapes inside quoted CSV fields.

features.name: Escaped Delimiters
features.description: Parses quoted fields containing a comma or an LF newline.

features.name: Header Mapping
features.description: Maps a reordered CSV header to the correct typed record members.

features.name: Custom Conversion
features.description: Converts sku-NNNN fields to the matrix-owned ProductCode value type.

features.name: Streaming Read
features.description: Aggregates 10,000 typed rows with forward-only reading and no row materialization.

features.name: Write Rows
features.description: Writes three records with a header to an exact LF-terminated CSV string.

features.name: Async Read
features.description: Asynchronously aggregates 10,000 typed CSV rows through the library async API.
